_note: SIMULATED teaching case — not a real patient. Use for demos and testing only.
working_title: Late-onset nodules after poly-L-lactic acid injection in the mid-face assessed with high-frequency ultrasound
key_message: High-frequency ultrasound distinguished non-inflammatory PLLA nodules from product clumping and guided low-dose intralesional steroid with resolution by Day 180.

patient.goal: Restore mid-face volume loss after weight reduction
medications: semaglutide 1.0 mg weekly for 10 months (stopped 2 months before treatment)

presenting_concern: Mid-face hollowing after 12 kg weight loss
clinical_findings: Bilateral submalar and zygomatic volume deficit; mid-face volume deficit scale grade 3 at baseline.

differential: residual HA from prior tear-trough filler

interventions.reconstitution: 8 mL sterile water + 1 mL lidocaine 2%, hydrated 48 h

interventions.summary: Intralesional triamcinolone 10 mg/mL, 0.1 mL per nodule, 3 nodules

tolerability: Mild bruising for 3 days after each session
